findings.rule: the part talked about is lit
findings.problem: The voice names three to the power negative two and its value one over nine, but neither the 3^{-2} on the line above nor the 1/9 on the new line is lit, so the student must search for which piece became which.
findings.fix: Light the 3^{-2} in the top of the line above as it is named, then light the 1/9 in the top of the new line on "one over nine".

findings.problem: The voice says only the twenty-sixes cancel, but the answer also needs three over nine to become one third, so the jump to −1/3 is not fully explained.
findings.fix: Add to the voice "and three over nine is one third" before "The answer is negative one third".

findings.problem: The common-mistake note sits under the Add power note, so its arrow points at that note instead of at the split line it is about.
findings.fix: Point the ✗ Common mistake arrow at the orange 3^n × 3^1 term on the split line, or place the note beside the Add power note so its arrow reaches that term.
